title: REQ · GameLayout hosts the header overlay and layout tests assert Tailwind classes
summary: GameLayout header slot and Tailwind-based layout.test.tsx
description: Context: GameLayout has no header slot; tests/layout.test.tsx still reads styles.css and checks legacy class strings. Desired behavior: GameLayout renders an optional header prop absolutely over main, and layout.test.tsx asserts Tailwind classes on root, main and aside plus header placement. Why: tests must match the Tailwind layout.
acceptance_criteria: Given a header prop, when GameLayout renders, then the header is inside main
Given layout.test.tsx, when read, then it contains no styles.css read nor legacy class-name strings, and asserts Tailwind classes
